name: Detail Info
summary: Shows a species' measurement, status, and caption as three labeled facts.
description: A small panel of up to three facts about a species: a size reading, a conservation status line, and a short caption, each paired with its own icon. It only renders the facts it's given, so a species missing a caption simply shows a shorter panel instead of an empty gap.
whenToUse: Following up a species card's title with its measurement, status, and a short note
Showing only one or two of the three facts when the others aren't known
whenNotToUse: Introducing a species for the first time — use the card's own title and image instead
Writing a long paragraph about a species — that belongs in the card's description text, not a fact row
dos: Give the status line room to wrap. It's written as a full sentence.
Keep a measurement to one short reading, like a range in millimeters.
Let the caption run onto a second line when it needs to.
donts: Don't force the status line onto one line. Let it wrap naturally.
Don't combine multiple readings into one line. Give each fact its own row.

notes: The icons carry no meaning on their own — the words next to them say what each fact is, so nothing is lost if an icon fails to load.
